messages.subject: OHLC bar chart and oscillators
parts:
Long time lurker, first time posting. I am generating traditional stock charts in ggplot2 like this:


library(ggplot2)

library(quantmod)


getSymbols("SPY", from = Sys.Date() - 1460, to = Sys.Date(), adjust = TRUE, auto.assign = TRUE)


input <- data.frame(SPY["2015/"])

names(input) <- c("Open", "High", "Low", "Close", "Volume", "Adjusted")

xaxis <- as.Date(index(input))

input$xaxis <- xaxis


p <- ggplot(input)

p <- p + geom_segment(aes(x = xaxis, xend = xaxis, y = Low, yend = High), size = 0.70)           # body

p <- p + geom_segment(aes(x = xaxis - 0.4, xend = xaxis, y = Open, yend = Open), size = 0.90)    # open

p <- p + geom_segment(aes(x = xaxis, xend = xaxis + 0.4, y = Close, yend = Close), size = 0.90)  # close


p



Now, I want add some indicators to a panel below the stock prices. For example, the RSI indicator which can be plotted with the quantmod package:




chartSeries(SPY["2015/"],

            name = "SPY",

            theme = chartTheme('white.mono', grid.col = NA),

            type = "bars",

            bar.type = 'ohlc',

            major.ticks = 'months',

            show.grid = FALSE,

            log.scale = TRUE,

            TA = c(addRSI(n = 14, maType = "SMA")))


addLines(h = c(80), on = 2, col = "#d7191c")

addLines(h = c(20), on = 2, col = "#1a9641")



I believe that I need to utilize facets and I have been trying to mimic this example, but I am really lost at translating my understanding of columnar/long xts data into a wide format. Thank you for your help!
